notes: Colophon names no person. The scribe refers to himself only as "mayā" in the stock verse yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā ... liṣitaṃ mayā; no name, king, place or commissioner given. Date ŚS 1646 caitra agrees with the catalogue field (c. March–April 1724 CE). Text title garbled: dharma yadhiṣṭI[ra] saṃmāde for dharmayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde; "ame" probably for a parvan name (e.g. anuśāsanaparvaṇi) or corrupt.
